name: forms
description: Declarative server-rendered form flows with CSRF, field validation and a confirmation page, rendered through ui.

oneOf.description: Project-relative module path; its default export is the hook.

source.description: Project-relative path of the trusted hook module, resolved like a function route source and re-imported on each activation.

export.description: Named export to call (default: the module default export).

sandbox.description: Schema-valid but refused at activation when true: extension hooks run trusted, in-process, and are never sandboxed.

sandboxReason.description: Reviewer note recorded with a sandbox choice; it grants nothing.

onSubmit.description: Action hook: Runs after the extension has admitted and validated a form submission, before the confirmation (a redirect, or the inline page with success.mode inline). It is trusted project code and receives only declared field values.

hooks.description: Trusted project hooks by name ({source, export} or a bare module path). onSubmit runs for every flow; sandbox: true is refused.

flows.description: Mounted form flows by name. Each needs a route <mount>/* with extension: forms (GET, HEAD, POST); a flow without its route, or a forms route without a flow, fails activation.

mount.description: URL path the flow is served at: the form on GET and POST, the confirmation at <mount>/confirmation.

title.description: Page heading and title of the form.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone (default UTC) that defines "today" for relative date bounds; refused at activation when unknown.

confirmation.description: The page a valid submission leads to.

message.description: Confirmation text; a {field} placeholder is replaced by that submitted value (escaped) and must be listed in show.

show.description: Declared fields whose submitted values the confirmation may display: carried in a sealed five-minute cookie on redirect, or rendered directly inline. Nothing else is echoed.

success.description: What a valid POST answers: redirect (default) is a 303 to <mount>/confirmation; inline renders the confirmation in the POST response.

status.description: Status of the inline confirmation (default 200); refused with mode redirect.

label.description: Visible label of the field; also names it in error messages and on the confirmation.

control.description: HTML control (default input). select needs options; checkbox takes no type or bounds and submits true or false.

type.description: Input type for an input control (default text); decides which bounds apply and how the value is checked.

required.description: Fields are required unless this is false. Not allowed together with requiredWhen.

minLength.description: Fewest characters a text value may have; not for number, date or checkbox fields.

maxLength.description: Most characters a text value may have; required (and bounded) when pattern is set.

minimum.description: Lower bound: a number for type number; for date and datetime-local an absolute YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM value, today, or {from: today, add: <duration>} in the flow's timeZone.

from.description: The flow's current date in its timeZone.

add.description: Signed ISO 8601 period of years, months and days added to today, for example P30D or -P18Y.

maximum.description: Upper bound, with the same forms as minimum; it must not be below minimum.

from.description: The flow's current date in its timeZone.

add.description: Signed ISO 8601 period of years, months and days added to today, for example P30D or -P18Y.

pattern.description: Regular expression the whole text value must match; checked for catastrophic backtracking at activation and requires maxLength.

enum.description: Exact values an input accepts, or the subset of a select's option values it accepts.

description.description: Help text rendered under the field.

requiredWhen.description: Makes the field required only when a sibling select or enum field was submitted once with one of the listed values, and optional otherwise. Replaces required; the sibling must not itself be conditional.

field.description: Name of the sibling field in this flow; it needs a fixed value set (a select or an enum input).

in.description: Values of the sibling that make this field required; each must be one the sibling accepts.

options.description: Choices of a select control, in display order; only select fields take options.

label.description: Visible text of the choice; the confirmation shows it for a shown select.

fields.description: The form's fields in display order, keyed by field name (the submitted name). A field not declared here is refused.

abuse.description: Per-flow submission budget through the abuse extension (node target only); the flow refuses to activate without abuse installed. Needs the runtime trusted-proxy boundary to key clients.

client.description: Submissions admitted per client network (IPv4 address or IPv6 /64); over it a POST answers 429 with Retry-After.

challengeAfter.description: After this many admitted submissions in the window, a submission must pass the operator challenge (abuse({challenge}) in host.mjs); must be below client.limit.

honeypot.description: Name of a hidden field humans leave empty; a submission that fills it is answered as a success and dropped. Must not be a declared field.

notify.description: Emails each accepted submission (template forms.submission) through the mail extension, after onSubmit and before the confirmation; the flow refuses to activate without mail. A failed delivery answers 503 and the visitor may resubmit, so delivery is at least once.

recipient.description: Operator-named recipient from mail({recipients}) in host.mjs; an address never appears in YAML.

include.description: Declared fields whose values the message carries as plain text (default none).

hooks.name: onSubmit
hooks.description: Runs after the extension has admitted and validated a form submission, before the confirmation (a redirect, or the inline page with success.mode inline). It is trusted project code and receives only declared field values.

flow.description: Name of the flow the submission belongs to (its key under flows).

values.description: Validated values of the declared fields, as strings keyed by field name (a checkbox is true or false); frozen.

authoring.description: Declare a bounded server-rendered form flow with fixed fields and a confirmation page that can show opted-in submitted values (confirmation.show), reached by a 303 redirect or, with success.mode inline, rendered in the POST response (200 or 201). The forms extension owns HTML escaping, admission, CSRF and field validation; attach auth on the mount when submissions need a signed-in caller.

surfaces.name: flows
surfaces.description: Declare each mounted form, its bounded fields, explicit submit label and confirmation page.

surfaces.name: success
surfaces.description: Optional per-flow success answer: `success: {mode: redirect}` (the default) answers a valid POST with 303 to `<mount>/confirmation`; `success: {mode: inline, status: 200|201}` renders the confirmation (title, message, opted-in `show` values, escaped) in the POST response itself, `no-store`, status 200 unless 201 is declared. `status` is refused with `mode: redirect`. CSRF, admission, validation (422) and onSubmit/notify ordering are the same in both modes.

surfaces.name: abuse
surfaces.description: Optional per-flow rate limit through the abuse extension (node only): `abuse: {client: {limit, windowMs}, challengeAfter?, honeypot?}`. Over the limit a POST gets 429 with Retry-After; above challengeAfter it must pass the operator's challenge (abuse({challenge}) in host.mjs); a filled honeypot field is accepted silently and dropped.

surfaces.name: notify
surfaces.description: Optional per-flow email through the mail extension: `notify: {recipient, include?}` sends forms.submission to the operator-named recipient (mail({recipients}) in host.mjs) after onSubmit, with the include fields as plain text. A failed delivery answers 503 and the visitor may resubmit, so delivery is at least once.

surfaces.name: onSubmit
surfaces.description: Optional trusted project action, called only after successful form validation and CSRF admission. It is not sandboxed and must keep external effects idempotent.

surfaces.name: mount
surfaces.description: Mount each flow as `/contact/*` with GET, HEAD and POST. Add `auth: {csrf: origin}` (never `auth: true`) when the form is for signed-in callers.

agent.description: Local, revision-pinned references for agents configuring the forms extension.

references.name: forms extension guide
references.description: Configuration and integration guidance for declarative form flows; ends with the generated field reference for every configuration key.
